We are on day 72 of Democrats’ DHS shutdown.

And next week, many of them will fly across the globe after voting for over two months against funding the agency that keeps our nation and secure. Their top priority is obstruction—not the American people.

This about the safety and security of not just President Trump, but ALL future presidents. 

Build the ballroom.

Video

I’m always grateful for the opportunity to thank our incredible veterans, including these brave men and women from the Wiregrass, for their service to our great nation.

Video

It is unconscionable that for over HALF of the fiscal year, the men and women of the Department of Homeland Security, including our brave Secret Service agents who protected the President and his team this weekend, have faced paycheck uncertainty due to Democrats’ government shutdown.

Video

My family and I will never forget April 27, 2011.

15 years later, we continue to reflect on the devastation Alabama experienced and the grace of God that carried us through.

Today, we remember the 252 Alabamians we lost and pray for the loved ones they left behind. Even in the face of unimaginable loss, we saw the strength, faith, and resilience that define Alabamians.

If you’re wondering why we have to have this conversation every six months…look no further.

This was the scene AFTER the attempt on President Trump’s and his Cabinet’s lives. This is sick and twisted.


Katie Pavlich (@KatiePavlich)

Meanwhile outside WHCD, the dude on the right hit me with his sign

End the political games and fund the Department of Homeland Security in its ENTIRETY. 

Secret Service, along with ALL of DHS, needs to be funded NOW.

The vilification and demonization of President Trump, his Cabinet, his supporters, law enforcement and ALL Americans must end.

We know where it leads, and political violence has no place in our country. End of story.


Bill Melugin (@BillMelugin_)

NEW: Per federal law enforcement sources familiar with the investigation to @FoxNews, Cole Allen told investigators after his arrest that his intent was to target Trump administration officials at the WHCD.

Wesley and I are praying for the safety of the President, the First Lady, and all those attending the White House Correspondents dinner. 

Grateful for the brave men and women in uniform working to keep everyone safe.

It was incredible to follow the Artemis II mission alongside our nation. Alabama was proud to cheer on the men and women at @NASA_Marshall who helped make it happen.

Video

I’m grateful for the friendship @SenFettermanPA and I have built in the Senate. 

The legacy media loves to show division, but it’s important for the American people to see trust and respect across the aisle as we work to deliver real results.

Video

Honored to spend time with Wiregrass Honor Flight veterans at the Capitol yesterday.

These Alabamians are American heroes who represent the very best of our state and our country. We are all deeply grateful for their service and sacrifice that make our freedoms possible.

.@SenFettermanPA and I don’t have to ask parents what it’s like to raise kids and teens, we’re living it.

The next generation is facing an unprecedented youth mental health crisis, directly correlated to the rise in social media, which is why we’re leading legislation in the Senate.

Video

This is an incredible step in the right direction, but there’s even more we can do. That’s why my bill, the Stop the Scroll Act with @SenFettermanPA, would place warning labels on social media platforms for minors that includes the 988 hotline. 

We know that the rise in social media directly correlates with our youth mental health crisis—it’s time for Congress to act.


Ellen Barry (@EllenBarryNYT)

Proud to stand with Alabama’s producers who work every day to feed and fuel our nation.

I appreciate @SecretaryWright’s decisive leadership and focus on putting consumers first via the Ratepayer Protection Pledge and Energy Dominance Financing. 

I look forward to continuing to partner with him to advance policies that not only result in rate freezes, but also result in electricity rates going down across Alabama.

Sheridan Gorman should still be with us today. Her murder was preventable, but due to reckless Biden-era open border policies, her murderer was allowed into our country. 

This tragedy reinforces the need to stand with ICE and CBP and fully fund DHS.


Rapid Response 47 (@RapidResponse47)

Every American needs to see this.

18-year-old Sheridan Gorman was brutally murdered in Chicago — just blocks from her college dorm — by an illegal alien who should never have been here.
